description: This PHP abstract class 'kintParser' provides a framework for parsing and representing various variable types, including objects, arrays, primitives, and resources for debugging or variable inspection purposes. It includes methods for initialization, recursion handling, type-specific parsing, and generating rich HTML representations.

classes.name: kintParser
classes.description: An abstract class that provides static methods and internal state management for parsing PHP variables into a structured format for debugging and visualization purposes.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes custom data types and object parsers by including PHP files from specific directories.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal static variables to initial state.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Main method to create a parsed representation of a variable, handling recursion, type-specific parsing, and alternative display options.

methods.name: _checkDepth
methods.description: Checks if the current recursion level exceeds the maximum allowed depth.

methods.name: _isArrayTabular
methods.description: Determines if a 2D array can be represented as a tabular structure.

methods.name: _decorateCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a table cell in the rich representation, including type and value decoration.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for safe HTML output depending on current mode.

methods.name: _parse_array
methods.description: Parses an array variable, handling recursion, depth, and tabular structures.

methods.name: _parse_object
methods.description: Parses an object, including its properties, reflecting access levels, and handling recursion.

methods.name: _parse_boolean
methods.description: Parses a boolean variable into a structured format.

methods.name: _parse_resource
methods.description: Parses resource variables, e.g., streams, and provides metadata like URI.

methods.name: _parse_string
methods.description: Parses string variables, managing encoding, length, and truncation for display.

methods.name: _parse_unknown
methods.description: Fallback parsing for unknown variable types, using var_export.
